jobs.description:
Business unit: Global Workplace Solutions
Role: Facilities Coordinator and Team Lead
Location: Central Stockholm, Sweden
Reporting line: Senior Facilities Manager, Nordics & Lithuania
 
CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) produces comprehensive property management services and solutions for its customers. We specialize in managing integrated real estate services, technical maintenance of real estate,project and project management services.
At CBRE Global Workplace Solutions we believe our working spaces should allow everyone to feel comfortable,productive and inspired in their working environment. Because when people feel inspired, great things happen. We are a workplace team providing Facility Services across EMEA for a prestigious global technology client.
 
Are you passionate about delivering world-class workspaces, building high-performing teams, and driving operational excellence? We are looking for an energetic and proactive Facilities Coordinator & Team Lead to champion our safety culture, elevate customer experiences, and lead the team of 3 facilities assistants.
 
In this role, you will be the driving force behind our site's daily success, blending exceptional service delivery, innovative problem-solving, and inspiring people management.
 
Core Responsibilities
Safety and culture champion
Actively foster an environment where safety comes first by logging quality hazards, closing out actions, and embedding compliance and RISE behaviors.
Maintain full adherence to CBRE and client health and safety policies, ensuring a secure environment for staff, contractors, and visitors while assisting with evacuation team training and drills.

 
Operational & Customer Excellence
Deliver the Ultimate Experience: Provide high-class, professional customer service that keeps our spaces running seamlessly.
Own the Environment: Take accountability for all facilities issues, proactively resolving remedial actions and maintaining immaculate space standards.
Comprehensive Support: Lead your team in delivering exceptional soft services
KPI & SLA Driven: Strive for excellence by consistently hitting and exceeding performance targets while building strong, collaborative relationships with client and supply partners.

 
Innovation & Impact
Take ownership of First Day of Business preparations and execution.
Drive Continuous Improvement: Champion fresh ideas, share best practices, and constantly look for smart innovations to improve contract performance.
Increase efficiency with the use of AI.

 
People Leadership & Development
Motivate & Recognize: Build a high-energy, engaged team culture through regular recognition and the performance management cycle.
Grow Talent: Understand team strengths, champion professional growth, and support succession planning with consistent, constructive feedback and one-on-ones.

 
Supplier & Financial Stewardship
Supervise & Support: Coordinate supplier personnel and subcontractors to ensure flawless service delivery and strict adherence to safety protocols (RAMS reviews, permits, and inductions).
Budget Management: Oversee operational budgets, handle invoicing and purchase orders, ensure compliance, and actively identify cost-saving opportunities for our client.

 
Finance
You oversee operational budget and accruals within contract guidelines and financial procedures ensuring spend compliance.
You are responsible for your budget and you manage all costs to ensure it is respected and address any related queries, including invoicing/ PO's that might arise.
You are continually looking for saving opportunities to reduce client costs.

 
Why Join Us?
This is a high-visibility, rewarding opportunity where your leadership will directly shape the daily experience of everyone on site. If you are a collaborative problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves bringing out the best in people, we want to hear from you!
 
Succeeding in this role:
Preferred higher educational qualifications (or equivalent)
Fluency in written and spoken English & Swedish languages with strong communication skills
Displays proactive day-to-day problem solving, with ownership and pride
A basic understanding of good health & safety practices, engages in Health & Safety culture
Experience in fostering high-performing teams
Proven financial accuracy and expertise
Ability to prioritize, whilst engaging in self development

 
What do we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits
Possibility to learn from leading global company producing real estate services
Awesome colleagues and exciting working environment
Welcoming you to CBRE's Performance Management cycle
 
Last date of application 20.12.2026
Got questions about the position? Reach out directly to Senior Facilities Manager Tiina Luukkonen,

The opportunity  
Shape the Future of HSE Governance within HVDC 
Are you passionate about management systems, governance, and continuous improvement? Do you enjoy creating structures from complexity, bringing people together, and turning requirements into practical solutions? 
As our HVDC HSE Management System Lead, you will play a key role in developing and improving the HVDC HSE Management System. Working across Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental & Energy Management, and Assurance, you will help strengthen the governance framework that supports a safe, sustainable, and high-performing organization. 
You will join a collaborative team that brings together different areas of HSE expertise, with a strong focus on shared ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement. If you have a solid foundation in management systems and enjoy working with people to create meaningful and lasting improvements, we would love to hear from you. 
This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden. 
How you’ll make an impact  
Shape and continuously improve the HVDC HSE Management System .  
Lead the HSE Governance process and help create clear, effective ways of working across the organization. You will act as Process leader. 
Drive alignment and integration of Environmental, Occupational Health & Safety, and Energy Management requirements. 
Partner closely with the Occupational Health & Safety Lead, Environmental & Energy Lead, and other Governance team members to ensure specialist requirements are effectively incorporated into the management system. 
Coordinate Management Reviews and help translate outcomes into continuous improvement. 
Simplify, harmonize, and improve governance processes, methodologies, tools, and documentation. 
Support the integration of HSE requirements into the wider HVDC Way. 

Your background 
Your experience and expertise are important, and we believe your personal qualities will be equally important to your success. 
You have experience in management systems, governance, process management, or continuous improvement, along with knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001. Experience with ISO 50001 is an advantage. 
You may have a degree in Engineering, Environmental Management, Occupational Health & Safety, Sustainability, Business Administration, or a related field, but we equally value relevant practical experience. 
You bring a structured and analytical approach and are comfortable turning complex requirements into practical solutions. 
You communicate clearly, build trust, and enjoy bringing people and different perspectives together. 
You are comfortable facilitating discussions, creating alignment, and driving improvements across organizational boundaries. 
You are curious and open-minded, with a willingness to learn and collaborate with experts across different disciplines. 
Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Swedish language skills are considered an advantage.  

More about us  
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​ 
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​ 
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​ 
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​ 
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​ 
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​ 
Health care and wellness allowance​ 
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​ 
Psychological support program​​ 
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​ 
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​ 
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​ 
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​ 

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

jobs.occupation: Medical Oncologists Wanted for Oncology Departments Across Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in medical oncology looking for a role that combines professional development, multidisciplinary collaboration, and access to modern cancer treatments?
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established oncology department in Sweden that provides comprehensive cancer care across a broad spectrum of diagnoses. You will join an experienced and supportive team where collaboration, clinical excellence and continuous development are highly valued.
This is an opportunity to work in a specialty that is constantly evolving, with access to modern therapies and the possibility to contribute to the ongoing development of cancer care while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
About the role
As a specialist in oncology, you will be involved in:
Outpatient consultations and follow-up of oncology patients.
Systemic cancer treatments and individualized treatment planning.
Participation in multidisciplinary tumour conferences (MDTs).
Inpatient care as part of a rotating ward responsibility.
Collaboration with radiation oncology, palliative care and other specialties.
Supervision and mentoring of resident doctors.
Contributing to the continued development of clinical pathways and oncology services.

Depending on your experience and professional interests, there are opportunities to further develop specific areas of expertise within the department.
Why this opportunity?

Collaborative and supportive environment: 
Join an experienced oncology team known for its strong collegial atmosphere, close cooperation and willingness to support one another.

Modern oncology practice:
Work in a department that continuously follows developments in cancer treatment and offers access to innovative therapies and evidence-based care.

Professional development:
Benefit from ongoing opportunities for continuing medical education, subspecialization and participation in developing multidisciplinary tumour teams.

Varied clinical work:
Combine outpatient care, inpatient responsibilities, multidisciplinary collaboration and specialised oncology treatments within a broad clinical practice.

Long-term career opportunities:
Become part of a stable department with low staff turnover and a strong commitment to quality improvement and professional growth.

Life in central Sweden
The position is located in a scenic region of central Sweden, offering an excellent quality of life with forests, lakes and coastline within easy reach. The area combines a welcoming community atmosphere with modern infrastructure, short commuting times and access to outdoor activities throughout the year.
Families appreciate the safe environment, excellent schools and generous work-life balance, while larger cities and international travel connections remain easily accessible.
Requirements
EU-recognised specialist certification in Medical Oncology.
Solid clinical experience as a specialist in oncology.
Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team.
Interest in teaching, supervision and professional development.
Strong communication skills in English.
Motivation to learn Swedish through our language programme.

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Interested in a career in Sweden?
Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Advance Your Career as a Radiologist in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Radiologists career opportunities across Sweden
Sweden currently has a strong need for specialist radiologists within both general diagnostic radiology and several subspecialties. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, radiologists from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within the Swedish healthcare system.
We collaborate with hospitals and imaging departments across Sweden, ranging from regional hospitals to large university hospitals. 
Our goal is to match your professional background, experience and preferences with the right workplace.
Radiologists in Sweden play a central role in clinical decision-making and work in close collaboration with physicians from many specialties. The work is primarily clinically focused and supported by modern imaging technology, digital reporting systems and well-structured workflows. Departments typically operate advanced diagnostic equipment including MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional radiography, supported by modern PACS systems.
Professional Development
The current need in Sweden is primarily for radiologists who wish to focus on clinical diagnostic work. Radiologists often work broadly within diagnostic radiology while gradually developing subspecialist expertise depending on their interests and the needs of the department. Multidisciplinary collaboration with clinicians is an important part of everyday work.
For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.
Relocation and Support
Relocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.
You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.
Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.
Support for your family
Many physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.
Language training
To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.
Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.
Living in Sweden
Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.
Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.
Requirements
We are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.
Interested?
Radiologists working in general diagnostic radiology as well as those with subspecialist expertise are welcome to explore opportunities with us.
Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Nordic Operations Analyst at PostNord, Stockholm.
jobs.description:
Nordic Operations Analytics Specialist: join PostNord as an Operations Analyst in Solna and turn data into better decisions.
Help shape the future of Nordic parcel operations. As an Operations Analyst at PostNord, with the role title Nordic Operations Analytics Specialist, you connect operational performance with customer, commercial and financial outcomes. If your background is as a Business Analyst, Logistics Analyst or Supply Chain Analyst, this is an opportunity to build analytical tools, uncover improvement opportunities and turn insights into measurable business impact. Based in Stockholm, Solna or another Nordic head office, you work across markets, influence portfolio decisions and help build analytical capabilities that make a difference.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
Make an impact across the Nordic parcel portfolio, work closely with teams across markets and build analytical capabilities that influence real business decisions. We offer you a flexible hybrid workplace with a prestige-free environment where we as a team help each other to reach our goals. We encourage self-sufficient leadership for development and career opportunities. In addition to the benefits mentioned above, we offer:
Work in a Nordic and flexible environment
Good insurance and occupational pension conditions
Wellness allowance & access to office gym and swimming pool
Employee benefits through PostNord´s own employee foundation PostNord Plus
Employment according to a collective agreement.

Your Responsibilities
You connect operational performance with customer, commercial and financial outcomes to guide portfolio decisions and improvements. Your responsibilities include:
Build dashboards, KPIs and scalable analytical tools with IT, turning business needs into better decision support.
Analyse volumes, flows, lead times, service quality and product usage to uncover root causes, risks and improvement opportunities.
Strengthen business cases and portfolio priorities with operational assumptions, impact assessments, sensitivity analysis and quantified improvement potential.
Provide analytical input and follow-up for product changes, launches and migrations across Nordic markets.
Define and govern common product master data structures and drive data quality improvements, while Product Specialists own product-specific data accuracy, maintenance and setup.
Turn findings into actionable recommendations with Product, Operations, Finance, CX, Commercial, Pricing, Digital and country teams to improve efficiency, customer experience and scalability.

The Bigger Picture
Nordic Parcel Product Management develops PostNord’s Nordic parcel portfolio. You report to Manager Solutions Area B2C, with an analytical mandate across all parcel product areas.
The role can be based at PostNord’s offices in Stockholm/Solna, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen. The hybrid working model includes three days per week at the office.
Our Expectations
You combine analytical depth with business understanding. You challenge assumptions with facts, make complex findings clear and work across functions to turn insight into action. Taking ownership of analytical quality and building tools and ways of working that make a difference comes naturally to you.
Your background includes experience in analytics, business control, operations development or improvement, product performance or BI/reporting, with strong skills in large-data-set and root-cause analysis.
An understanding of operations, product performance, flows and service quality in logistics or another relevant industry is essential. Connecting these with customer, commercial, digital and financial outcomes is an advantage.
Experience building dashboards, KPIs and analytical models, and developing scalable tools with IT, is also required. You understand master data structures, reporting dimensions and data quality improvement, and bring stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills in a Nordic or matrix environment.
You hold a university degree, college degree or equivalent higher education qualification, and are fluent in spoken and written English and at least one Nordic language.
Interested?
We work with TNG in this recruitment process. If you are interested in this position, apply right now! The selection process is ongoing and the position can be filled before the last apply-date. If you have any questions, please contact the recruiter.

jobs.occupation: Business Performance Manager to BA Biomaterials
jobs.description:
Job description
Business Performance Manager – BA Biomaterials, Stora Enso
Are you ready to bridge the gap between commercial strategy and data-driven analytics in a global company leading the transition to a circular bioeconomy? We are now looking for a Business Performance Manager to join Stora Enso Biomaterials in Stockholm or Helsinki. About the Role As Business Performance Manager within our Sales, Marketing & Supply Chain organization, you will play a pivotal role in driving commercial excellence and profitability. This role blends the hands-on analytical depth of a business controller with the strategic problem-solving and advisory mindset of a management consultant. Acting as a trusted business partner to Sales, you will translate complex commercial and financial data into actionable insights. You will provide critical decision support on pricing, customer and product portfolios, and account planning—helping our commercial teams make sharper, data-backed decisions.  

The position is based in Stockholm or Helsinki, offering a hybrid way of working that combines office collaboration with remote flexibility. You will report to the Head of Marketing & Sales Excellence. Occasional travel may be required. We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded professional who effortlessly navigates complex data while keeping an eye on the bigger strategic picture. You thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy challenging the status quo, and actively look for ways to elevate commercial processes through data, digitalization, and technology. 

You are structured, take end-to-end ownership from initial analysis to follow-up, and excel at building strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders at all levels. Please submit your application through our recruitment tool as soon as possible, as we review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. 
For more information about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Consultant Jeanette Walters at (jeanette.walters@randstad.se).

Responsibilities
Drive and develop structured commercial performance management, including defining relevant KPIs and conducting regular performance follow-ups. 
Build, maintain, and continuously improve Power BI dashboards and analytical models to empower business decision-making. 
Analyze profitability across customers, products, and markets to pinpoint key performance drivers and recommend concrete improvement actions. 
Provide analytical leadership and decision support on pricing, customer and product portfolio optimization, and account planning. 
Own and evolve pricing principles as well as contracting governance. 
Monitor and evaluate Sales Incentive Programs and sales overdue reporting. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Controlling, IT, and Legal to streamline and enhance commercial processes and ways of working.

Qualifications
Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). 
Several years of experience in commercial performance management, business/sales controlling, management consulting, or a similar analytical role. 
Strong grasp of commercial drivers, pricing strategies, profitability analysis, and performance management. 
Proven track record of developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, as well as leveraging CRM and ERP systems for data-driven decision-making. 
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations and tangible business actions. 
Strong communication and presentation skills, paired with experience working across diverse functions and stakeholder groups. 
Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in Swedish or Finnish is considered a strong advantage. 

About the company

Stora Enso AB
Stora Enso is a global leader in renewable materials with a strong focus on
packaging. Our purpose is to replace non-renewable materials with renewable
solutions. Together with our customers, we design and deliver competitive, high-
quality packaging materials and solutions, made from fresh and recycled fibers,
accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy. Stora Enso has
approximately 19,000 employees and our sales in 2025 were EUR 9.3 billion.
We believe that diversity strengthens our competitiveness and leads to better
decisionmaking. Diverse teams with different backgrounds help us explore new
perspectives and challenge our ways of thinking. We actively work to increase
diversity in the workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Stora
Enso is an equal opportunity employer that follows nondiscriminatory practices.

jobs.occupation: ERP Programme Planning Specialist – Global ERP Transformation
jobs.description:
ERP Programme Planning Specialist – Global ERP Transformation
Are you an experienced ERP Programme Planning Specialist who enjoys bringing structure, clarity and control to complex international transformation programmes? Do you thrive in an environment where planning, resource management and collaboration are essential to successful delivery?
We are currently looking for an experienced ERP Programme Planning Specialist for an exciting consulting assignment with one of our clients, a leading international company within the industrial sector, based in Lund, Sweden.
This is an opportunity to play an important role in a large-scale global ERP transformation programme, working closely with international teams, project managers and senior stakeholders.
About the role
As an ERP Programme Planning Specialist, you will be part of a Transformation Management Office (TMO), supporting the planning and coordination of multiple ERP rollout projects.
Your main focus will be to create and maintain a clear, integrated overview of programme timelines, milestones, resources and risks, ensuring that programme leadership has the information needed to make informed decisions.
The role combines strategic programme planning with hands-on coordination, analysis and continuous improvement.
Your main responsibilities
Develop and maintain an integrated programme plan across multiple ERP rollout projects.

Coordinate milestones, schedules and dependencies across international teams and workstreams.

Manage resource allocation, capacity planning and forward-looking resource forecasts.

Identify resource bottlenecks, scheduling conflicts and potential delivery risks.

Maintain programme-wide risk registers with clear ownership and escalation procedures.

Monitor programme progress and provide structured reporting to senior stakeholders.

Analyse planning, resource and risk data to support informed decision-making.

Support scenario planning, prioritisation and replanning when programme requirements change.

Collaborate closely with project managers, business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment across the programme.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a structured, analytical and proactive professional with solid experience in large-scale ERP implementations, international system rollouts or complex business transformation programmes.
You understand the challenges of coordinating multiple projects, managing dependencies and ensuring that resources are effectively planned and utilised.
You are comfortable working in international environments, communicating with senior stakeholders and translating complex information into clear, actionable insights.
Key skills and experience
Proven experience in programme planning, PMO/TMO or large-scale ERP transformation programmes.

Experience coordinating international ERP implementations or system rollouts.

Strong understanding of integrated programme planning and milestone management.

Practical experience in resource management, capacity planning and forecasting.

Experience identifying and managing risks and dependencies across multiple projects.

Strong analytical skills and experience working with planning and resource data.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to work independently while maintaining a programme-wide perspective.

Excellent communication skills in English.

Nice to have
Experience with SAP or other enterprise ERP platforms.

Background in global transformation programmes within industrial or manufacturing organisations.

Experience with programme planning, reporting or resource management tools.

Experience supporting senior leadership with scenario analysis and decision-making.

About you
You are a solution-oriented and detail-focused professional who enjoys creating structure in complex environments.
You have a proactive mindset, strong communication skills and the ability to bring people together across different functions and geographical locations.
You understand the importance of balancing long-term programme objectives with day-to-day operational priorities and enjoy contributing to successful transformation initiatives.
Assignment details
Location: Lund, Sweden Work arrangement: Hybrid (on-site presence required) Assignment type: Consulting assignment Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement Duration: Until 22 July 2027 Working hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
Does this sound like you?
We would love to hear from you!
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
Please submit your application through our application portal, as applications sent directly via email will not be considered.

• Ensure the continuous development of your team and continue to build a team with high level of team spirit and engagement.
• Align your work and the team’s contribution to the bank’s direction and strategy. 
What is needed in this role:

Extensive experience in Foreign Exchange (FX), including FX sales and advisory services for corporate clients.

Proven ability to drive sales growth, business performance and sustainable results.

Strong relationship management skills, with experience engaging senior decision-makers and key stakeholders.

Excellent communication and presentation skills in both Swedish and English.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or equivalent relevant experience.

Ability to lead in line with Swedbank's values: Open, Simple and Caring.

With us, you can experience:
Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance.

This is our team...
We are a dedicated and successful team with many experienced professionals. We work with a proactive sales responsibility towards corporate and institutional clients across both Swedbank and the Savings Banks, where we offer products based on the customers' needs. In our team we value teamwork and we expect you to be a collaborative and engaged team player!
As leaders, we trust our people and delegate responsibility, we strive to build a team with an open, positive and transparent environment, where everyone can grow and have the possibility to learn from each other." Cornelia Reifeldt, your future manager.

jobs.occupation: Future Talent - Development Engineer Packaging Material
jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
 Start your career development and become Tetra Pak’s next Future Talent! We are looking for highly motivated newly graduates to join us in 2027! 
 
 
Future Talent Programme is a Trainee Programme within Tetra Pak. We offer a permanent position from start in September 2027 at our site in Lund. You will onboard an individually designed development programme for 18 months connected to a specific position and the Tetra Pak organization. During the programme you will participate in trainings and job rotations throughout various parts of Tetra Pak to explore your potential and grow as a person. As a Trainee here with us, you will get to know our entire business and collaborate with colleagues all over the world. And this is just the beginning of your Tetra Pak career!
 
In Materials & Package we are responsible for the industrial lifecycle management and specification management for all packaging materials, packages, openings, closures & paper straws, secondary package and other additional materials for packaging solutions.
 
Visit https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/future-talent and read more about Tetra Pak Future Talent Programme!
 
This position belongs to the Leadership Track.
 
You will be based in Lund, Sweden but you will work in a global arena.
What you will do
As our new Future Talent – Development Engineer Packaging Material you will:
 
Develop new innovative material solutions to meet our customer needs and our sustainability commitments
Work in a cross-functional scrum team where you will turn science into practice and drive the development of material from idea to market release
Design and evaluate the performance and functionality of the material, build knowledge, and participate in problem solving together with specialists and stakeholders
Coordinate test activities and work closely with laboratories, factories and specialists globally. You will work in the test facilities as well as working at your desk analysing data and writing reports and communicating results to stakeholders

We believe you have
You have a Masters Degree in Material Science or equivalent (Graduated 2026-2027)
It is possible that you have experience working with paperboard, polymers, packaging or recycling
You are fluent in English, written and spoken
You have good communications skills, written and spoken
Previous international studies/experience are considered meritorious

We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

 
Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what's good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. 
This job posting expires on 2026-12-08
To know more about the position contact Karin Olsson at +46 46 36 3124
Questions about your application contact Josephine Malalla at +46 46 36 5253
For trade union information, contact Akademikerklubben Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533 and Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320
 
Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.  
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future. 
Role Summary  
As a Project Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting a large-scale People & Culture transformation project at Scania. You will work closely with the Program Manager to coordinate project activities, monitor progress, prepare management reporting, and ensure alignment across multiple workstreams. The role combines hands-on project coordination with exposure to program management, governance activities, and strategic decision-making. This is an opportunity to contribute to a major HR transformation while developing your project management expertise in a dynamic and cross-functional environment. 
Job Responsibilities
Support project planning, coordination, and follow-up activities across multiple workstreams. 
Collect, consolidate, and analyze project data, progress updates, and KPIs. 
Prepare reports, presentations, and decision-making materials for management and governance forums. 
Maintain project documentation, including project plans, risk registers, issue logs, and decision logs. 
Coordinate project meetings, workshops, and stakeholder forums. 
Monitor milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables together with business and IT stakeholders. 
Support HR systems implementation, enhancement, and decommissioning activities. 
Follow up on actions and help drive project activities forward. 
Contribute to continuous improvements in project governance, reporting, and ways of working. 

Who You Are
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. 
Minimum 3 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or a similar role. 
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure, analyze, and present data. 
Experience preparing management presentations and project reporting materials. 
Strong communication skills and experience presenting to senior management. 
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. 
Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills. 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken. 

This Is Us
You will join a team driving the modernization of Scania's HR system landscape and People & Culture processes. Together with colleagues from HR, IT, Analytics, Process, Architecture, and Payroll, you will contribute to delivering sustainable improvements that simplify the employee experience and support Scania's strategic transformation journey. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and a proactive approach to solving challenges. 
Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. 
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje. 
Application
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-01. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 
We look forward to your application!
